findings.summary: The new prefix check `[[ $comp == "$cur"* ]] || continue` no longer skips empty completion lines. With an empty `$cur`, blank or description-only lines are added to COMPREPLY as empty candidates. This shows blank rows and can turn a single match into two, which skips the single-match path that strips the description.

judge.reason: Describes the empty completion line being added to COMPREPLY when $cur is empty, due to the new prefix check.

findings.summary: The no-description fast path (line 183) filters with `compgen -W`, but the description path now uses a literal prefix match. Entries with spaces or `$` are handled differently, so the same completion list can give different results depending on whether any entry has a description.

judge.reason: The inconsistency between compgen -W and literal prefix matching is a real behavioral difference, but it isn't the empty-candidate bug.
